newsitem.title: FRANCE: French justice minister projected to lose seat.
newsitem.headline: French justice minister projected to lose seat.

text.p: Conservative French Justice Minister Jacques Toubon is set to lose his seat in Paris to a socialist rival, a projection showed after the parliamentary election run-off on Sunday.

Toubon was likely to win 48 percent of the vote in the capital's 13th district, against 52 percent for socialist candidate Serge Blisko, according to the BVA projection broadcast on France 2 television.
